# Preeti Scaffolding

> Preeti Scaffolding is a Mumbai-based scaffolding company run by proprietor Vijay Shukla. It rents and sells scaffolding material (H-Frame, MS H-Frame, Cuplock, ladders, aluminium and accessories) and provides skilled erection and dismantling labour across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai.

Address: A 4/8, Jai Hind Society, Khadi No. 03, 90 Ft Road, Sakinaka, Kurla West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400072. Phone: +91 99873 17357 / +91 93242 93900. Email: vijayshukla301@gmail.com. GST: 27MAAPS9233F1ZA. For pricing, contact the business directly; prices depend on material, quantity, duration and site.

## Services

- [Scaffolding rental in Mumbai](https://www.shuklascaffolding.com/scaffolding-rental-mumbai/): H-Frame, MS H-Frame, Cuplock and accessories on rent
- [Scaffolding material in Mumbai](https://www.shuklascaffolding.com/scaffolding-material-mumbai/): scaffolding material and components for sale
- [Scaffolding labour in Mumbai](https://www.shuklascaffolding.com/scaffolding-labour-mumbai/): erection and dismantling labour teams
